entities.summary: Baron Heinrich Freiherr von Stackelberg was a German economist who contributed to game theory and industrial organization and is known for the Stackelberg leadership model. Stackelberg became a member of the Nazi Party in 1931 and held the rank of Scharführer (sergeant) in the Schutzstaffel.
